home.title: 3+2 Specialty Coffee
home.subtitle: Where Family Passion Meets Coffee Craft
home.description: Founded by three sisters and two brothers united by a reverence for specialty beans. From micro-lot origins to meticulous roasting and deliberate extraction, every cup is crafted as one perfect experience.
home.featuredSubtitle: Curated by our baristas from the finest single-origin harvests
home.quality1Desc: Direct trade, ethically sourced green coffee beans from high-altitude estates across Ethiopia, Colombia, and Yemen.
home.quality2Desc: Roasted in small batches to preserve terroir, delicate floral aromatics, and nuanced fruit notes.
home.quality3Desc: Manual V60, Kalita, and dialled espresso extractions calibrated daily to water chemistry and grind micron precision.
home.storyText: 3+2 is the story of five siblings — three sisters and two brothers — who grew up around coffee tables filled with laughter, curiosity, and lively debate. Each brought a distinctive perspective: scientific brewing precision, culinary flavour pairing, artistic visual identity, warm hospitable service, and meticulous green sourcing. Together, they established 3+2 Specialty Coffee to celebrate that harmony. Here, simplicity is refined, quality is non-negotiable, and every guest is served one perfect cup.
